nvitk.transform.projection
==========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.transform.projection

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Intensity projections along a volume axis.



Attributes
----------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.transform.projection._PROJECTION_METHODS


Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.transform.projection.project_along_axis
   nvitk.transform.projection._project_affine
   nvitk.transform.projection._permute_axes_string
   nvitk.transform.projection.project_volume


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: _PROJECTION_METHODS

.. py:function:: project_along_axis(volume: numpy.ndarray, axis: int, method: str) -> numpy.ndarray

   Collapse *volume* along *axis* using *method* (max, mean, median, min, std, sum).


.. py:function:: _project_affine(affine: numpy.ndarray | None, axis: int, out_ndim: int) -> numpy.ndarray | None

   Drop the projected *axis* from a 4x4 affine, keeping the surviving spatial columns.

   Returns ``None`` when the geometry cannot be represented (bad shape / too few axes).


.. py:function:: _permute_axes_string(axes: str | None, axis: int) -> str | None

   Drop the character at *axis* from an axis-label string (the projected-out axis).


.. py:function:: project_volume(image: nvitk.types.Image, *, axis: int, method: str = 'max') -> nvitk.types.Image

   Return a new :class:`~nvitk.types.Image` projected along *axis*.
